        Source quality and considerations

        The source contains valid lead records and campaign-level CPLs but not impression, click, delivery-date, acceptance, opportunity, pipeline, or revenue fields. Reporting therefore focuses on delivery, audience mix, calculated spend, and transparent operational signals.

        Unpriced delivered campaigns

        Delivered volume excluded from spend calculations

        Methodology

        Calculated spend: campaign CPL multiplied by delivered leads with an exact campaign-name match.

        High engagement: unique contacts per normalized account compared with editable company-size thresholds. Account size uses the largest category observed.

        Cap overflow: valid rows where Delivered is No.

        Direct PII: names, email addresses, and phone numbers are not embedded in this dashboard.
        Prepared from the supplied Canva Q2 FY26 lead file and Client Spends file. Spend figures use exact campaign-name matches and campaign-level CPLs. This client-facing artifact excludes direct personal identifiers but contains confidential campaign and account-level business data; share only through approved channels.
